(TRIVALENT)"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D28","page":1,"quote":"-0.009"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D29","page":1,"quote":"-0.025"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D36","page":1,"quote":"-0.009"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D37","page":1,"quote":"-0.025"}],"comment":"The Ø40 g6 shaft section (F21, D28/D29) and the Ø35 g6 shaft section (F27, D36/D37) carry tight ISO fits on a part that is zinc plated per the title block, but no allowance is made for plating thickness. The added coating will push these diameters oversize and cause interference in what should be a clearance or transition fit; the designer must reduce the pre-plate dimensions by the expected plating build-up or specify masking of the bearing seats.","recommended_correction":"Reduce the nominal diameters of the g6 sections by twice the maximum plating thickness, or add a note specifying that these surfaces are to be masked during I.Z.B.P. plating."}]}
